title: Leafic launches on iOS
excerpt: I just launched Leafic on iOS Here's your new favourite plant app: Diagnose, identify, and track your plants.
analysis: The post opens with a product reveal line. That label comes from the post text, not from watching the video. Reported 297 views and 3 likes on the gallery listing, a like rate of 1.01 percent, above the library median of 0.56 percent. At 35 seconds it compares best with the 30 second structure.
